abi.calling_convention: cdecl-compatible from one stack argument and RET

stack_arguments.observed_use: Signed comparison with -1, followed by unsigned CMP EAX,3 / JA table bounds check

abi.return_semantics: Returns the selected mutable global float exactly; all levels outside 0 through 3 return positive 0.0F.

mechanics: PUSH ECX allocates a four-byte local slot that is initialized to +0.0F; it is not a hidden receiver.
Only the signed input value -1 enters the lookup path.
The lookup calls 0x00b3d300, passes EAX in ECX to 0x00b1fdb0, reads the resulting vtable pointer, and calls slot vtable+0xd8 with no stack arguments.
CMP EAX,3 followed by JA implements an unsigned upper-bound check, so only 0, 1, 2, and 3 reach the jump table.
The four cases read mutable globals 0x01582e38, 0x01582e3c, 0x01582e40, and 0x01582e44 in that order.
Every other result returns the preinitialized +0.0F local.

state_evidence.null_and_sentinel_behavior: No null checks exist for the root pointer, noun manager, object pointer, vtable pointer, or virtual slot. The -1 sentinel triggers lookup; other negative values and values above 3 return +0.0F without lookup.

evidence.observation: Live function range is 0x00d2e380 through 0x00d2e3fd with one signed int parameter and float return.
Live decompilation preserves the -1 lookup, four global cases, and zero default.
Exact assembly shows PUSH ECX as local storage, RET without cleanup, unsigned JA, jump table, and vtable+0xd8 dispatch.
Raw target bytes confirm the local-slot interpretation and complete four-case table.
Initial threshold words decode to 1000.0F, 2000.0F, 3000.0F, and 5000.0F.
The second helper is ECX-only and returns the receiver field at +0x54.

confidence.virtual_slot_semantics: medium; slot behavior is observed, concrete implementation is unresolved

unresolved_questions: The concrete object type and implementation behind vtable slot +0xd8 are unresolved.
The owner and later writers of the four mutable threshold globals are not established by this target.
No original-process -1 lookup result or customized threshold values have been observed.
blockers: Runtime noun-manager/object availability and actual vtable dispatch remain gated.
